items.name: Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary: Google's new flagship AI model tops coding and automation benchmarks (77.9% on DeepSWE, first on AutomationBench) with an industry-leading 1M-token output limit, but Google is withholding it from public release — restricting access to a vetted group of cybersecurity experts while the US government gets early access.

items.name: OpenAI UltraFast
items.summary: New premium inference tier announced at DevDay that pushes token generation to 300 per second — 8x faster in Codex, 6x in the API — at 6x the standard price. Available now for GPT-6 Astra, with GPT-6.1 Sol support coming soon.

items.name: Pienomial AT0M
items.summary: New Delhi-based Pienomial launched AT0M, an enterprise-owned 'System One' decision model that never generates free text — it picks from developer-defined options, trains and runs entirely on-premises hardware, and beat TypeSafe's Jev on the typed-decisions benchmark (78.9% vs 74%).

items.name: Codex Security Cloud
items.summary: OpenAI's new DevDay product scans GitHub repositories for vulnerabilities, investigates findings, removes duplicates and prepares fixes — and can run on a schedule. It pairs with Codex Cloud, which keeps coding tasks running remotely while your laptop is closed.

items.name: OpenAI Agents API (public beta)
items.summary: OpenAI put its Agents API into public beta at DevDay with hosted execution, memory, tools and multi-agent support — including computer-use agents that operate software through its UI, plus a Decisions API in limited preview built on GPT-6 Luna.
